analysis_policy.water_near: Prior frame0 [745,170,35,30] translated by original union bounding-box displacement from frame0, intersect background. Sampling window follows subject, not tracked water material.
analysis_policy.MAE: Mean abs RGB8 difference vs input RGB on each exact region; empty regions N/A.
analysis_policy.gradient_energy_ratio: Sobel3x3 on full-image grayscale(.299,.587,.114), RGB normalized0-1; mean(gx^2+gy^2) on3x3-eroded region, divided by corresponding input energy. Empty gradient support or input energy<=1e-15: N/A. No mask-induced artificial edges; not a bokeh quality score or directly identical to historical rectangle-crop metric.
analysis_policy.temporal: 18->19,19->20,20->21,21->22,22->23: fixed image-coordinate union of each pair's supplementary head-context rectangles. Report per-method RGB8 temporal MAE, input-relative temporal-change residual and R-minus-A temporal response, plus A-repeat noise. No motion compensation; call region change, not flicker.
analysis_policy.repeat: Actually compare float32 uint32 bit patterns and RGB8 bytes; if nonidentical retain quantified repeat noise, no automatic quality judgement.

approval.next_step: 按现有revision1规则准备原版、重复原版与规则修正版的完整25帧配对推理；既定4帧跳过策略不变，重点复核20帧后的条件停止和跨帧响应。

selection_rule.coordinate_system: Original VDA/DAVIS1920x1080 pixel grid; d=q/255, normalized disparity, not metric depth.
selection_rule.test: abs(d_t-r_t)>0.10 within original DAVIS ID!=0 union; strict greater-than; two-sided.
selection_rule.multiple_components: Keep all qualifying components, including both higher/lower disparity sides; never select a winner.
selection_rule.too_large_policy: If union of all size-qualified components exceeds25% of subject, skip entire frame. Retain raw candidate visualization and reasons.
selection_rule.rationale: Input-only abs-difference medians0.035-0.078, most95th percentiles0.13-0.18. A single round0.10 threshold targets a disparity tail rather than all subject pixels; it is not an error detector.64 native pixels removes tiny islands; a conservative quarter-subject cap prevents broad intervention. No threshold/area sweep or output-based selection.
selection_rule.failure_policy: Invalid reference or empty candidates: retain original condition; no interpolation. No forced correction on all25 frames.
selection_rule.status: single proposal for user selection review; no user approval and no ATB inference
